root_cause.idb-keyval-update-lint-ban: No eslint and no test guarded against idb-keyval update(), which never settles on a get error/abort; only code comments warned.
root_cause.rumor-journal-real-idb-suite: rumorJournal.test.ts runs on a Map mock; recordRumorFailure failure paths, ack/remembered-ack, listing, sweep, per-group clear and identity read were never run under real IDB semantics with fault injection.
root_cause.leave-fallback-identity-writeback: REJECTED (remediation round 1): a live capture may read a re-joined membership's leaf, so writing it onto the old rumor could evict the re-joined member on replay; only an epoch-bound capture would be sound and live handling cannot obtain it. Prior behaviour kept: a replayed identity-less leave is skipped.
root_cause.leave-clearpolldata-unguarded: leaveGroupImpl awaited clearPollData bare; a rejection aborted the rest of the purge, the MLS-state destroy, reloadGroups and markBackupDirty (the startup sweep never re-runs the purge).
root_cause.poll-pending-queues-recreated-after-purg: Queue adds/removals were get-then-set outside a transaction (a read before and a write after clearPollData's purge transaction re-created the key), cap rejects rewrote unchanged lists, and adds from handlers in flight for a left group wrote after the purge. TTL is only applied on read, so the key persisted.
